title: Growing Number of Apps Help Adults Make Friends
paragraphs: Making new friends can be difficult for many adults, especially after they leave school or move to a new city. In a 2023 survey by YouGov, 21% of adults said it was "very difficult" to make new friends. Now, a growing number of smartphone apps are trying to help.

According to the technology news site TechCrunch, there are now more than a dozen apps designed to help people meet new friends near where they live. These apps offer many different ways to connect, from group dinners to activities for people over 40.

One of the best-known apps is Bumble BFF, which was created by the dating app company Bumble. Like a dating app, it lets users look through profiles and send messages to people they match with. In September 2025, Bumble relaunched the app with a new focus on groups. Users can now create or join groups, chat together and plan events using a calendar in the app. According to a survey by Bumble, 47% of people said they wanted more friends to do activities with.

Another popular app is Timeleft. Instead of chatting online first, users are matched with a small group of strangers and meet them for dinner at a restaurant chosen by the app. In Italy, an app called Tablo lets users create a "social dinner table" at a bar or restaurant, and anyone can join. By 2025, it had about 600,000 active members. There is also an app called Hey Vina!, which is only for women and has been described as the "Tinder for friends."
Why are these apps becoming popular? One reason is loneliness. According to a 2024 study, 57% of young Europeans feel lonely.
However, users say that apps cannot guarantee real friendships. Making close friends still takes time, regular meetings and good chemistry between people.
